info.title: ApiToolKit - Google Tag Manager API
info.description: ASP.NET Core Clean Architecture integration for Tag Manager API v2: accounts, containers, workspaces, tags, triggers, variables, versions and publishing. Connect a Google account with GET /api/tagmanager/auth/url?accountKey=..., then pass the same accountKey to every endpoint.

get.summary: Get the Google OAuth 2.0 consent URL. accountKey is any name you choose for this Google account; reuse it on every other endpoint.
OAuth 2.0 callback. Google sends the code and the accountKey (as state); tokens are stored for that account key.
